description: Source code for the MainActivity and related fragments of an Android grocery shopping app, handling UI setup, theme toggling, bottom navigation, cart badge display, and fragment navigation.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity hosting core navigation, theme toggle, floating cart badge, and fragment management.

classes.name: SearchFragment
classes.description: Placeholder fragment for Search tab with simple text view.

classes.name: ProfileFragment
classes.description: Placeholder fragment for Profile tab with simple text view.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initial setup: applies theme, sets content view, initializes bottom navigation, sets up cart badge overlay, and observes cart item count.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu and updates icons and description based on current theme mode.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles theme toggle action, updates preferences, and recreates activity to apply theme.

methods.name: updateCartFabBadge
methods.description: Updates the badge overlay with the number of items in the cart.

methods.name: openFragment
methods.description: Replaces the current fragment with a new one.
